aboutview.contactBody: Email: hello@rogikotha.example (this is a design exploration — the address is not monitored). For real emergencies, do not use this site.
aboutview.contactBodyProduct: Email: hello@rogikotha.example. For real emergencies, do not use this site.
aboutview.intro: RogiKotha is a place where patients publish first-hand experiences of doctors, hospitals and clinics in Bangladesh. It is not a medical service, not a directory of paid listings, and not a place to ask for medical advice.
aboutview.limitsBody: RogiKotha does not diagnose, does not verify whether a treatment was correct, and does not decide whether care was negligent. Accounts are patient reports — they tell you what one person experienced, not what will happen to you. If you are deciding what to do about a health problem, talk to a qualified clinician, not to this site.
aboutview.modBody: Before publication your experience runs through automated checks for duplicates, and for private details, spam and threatening language in the text. Files are scanned for malware and converted to a safe format. None of these judge your story or decide whether your care was good or bad. Nothing is published without your confirmation. After publication, unsafe advice is handled by people — readers report it and a moderator reviews it. Nothing is classified automatically.
aboutview.privacyBody: You can write under your real name, a pseudonym, or anonymously. You decide which one. If you write under a pseudonym, your real name is never stored with the experience. If you upload documents, you black out private details yourself before publishing and confirm you have done so — RogiKotha does not detect or remove them for you.
aboutview.reviewerBody: A reviewer label is the label chosen by the person who wrote the experience, for their own experience — for example “Wrong diagnosis” or “Second opinion differed”. It is their claim, not our finding. RogiKotha does not check whether it is medically correct, and no doctor confirms it on our behalf. Labels are always shown as words written by the reviewer.
aboutview.title: About RogiKotha

terms.eligibilityBody: You must be 18 or older and describe care you received or personally witnessed. You are responsible for what you publish, and you may be asked to correct or remove details that identify other private people.
terms.enforcementBody: Anyone can report content. Reports from several different confirmed accounts can hide content temporarily until a moderator reviews it. Moderators may redact identifiers, remove files, warn, hide or restrict — they never rewrite your account of care. You can appeal every decision.
